# OPENLANE Europe extends its partnership with EUROCOC to keep cross-border sales moving faster


** 11 Feb 2026


**Cross-border vehicle transactions in Europe are full of opportunity— and with the right paperwork in place, everything moves smoothly and efficiently. One document in particular often determines how quickly a vehicle can be registered and put back on the road: the Certificate of Conformity or COC.**


That’s why we at OPENLANE Europe have officially extended our partnership with EUROCOC—continuing our joint mission to make COCs easier to access and cross-border vehicle sales more efficient for automotive professionals across Europe.


## Why the partnership matters


When a COC is missing, the vehicle registration process can become more of a hassle: delays, additional administration, and uncertainty about next steps can follow, especially when vehicles move between different EU markets.


By renewing this collaboration, **we continue to reduce friction in one of the most common bottlenecks in cross-border remarketing** .


#### Save on your COC order with a dedicated promo code via[EUROCOC](https://bit.ly/4kCJpAt) :


#### OPENLANE10


## What customers can expect


By bringing together digital vehicle marketplace and EUROCOC’s compliance expertise, we continue to deliver practical value to our customers where it counts most: speed, simplicity, and clarity.


Here’s what this ongoing collaboration delivers for you as an automotive professional:


1


##### Faster, hassle-free access to Certificates of Conformity (COCs)


When a COC isn’t available for your vehicle, you can order one quickly online via[EUROCOC](https://bit.ly/4kCJpAt) .


2


##### A smoother experience alongside vehicle remarketing


The process is designed to fit naturally into a remarketing workflow—helping you keep deals moving rather than pausing for paperwork.


3


##### More efficient cross-border sales across Europe


Less administrative delay means vehicles can move from purchase to registration faster—helping you reduce standstill time and improve turnover.

## Want to learn more about COCs?


If you’d like to understand what a Certificate of Conformity is, why it matters, and when you need it, you can consult our[FAQ question on COCs here](https://info.openlane.eu/en/help/faq/for-buyers/car-documents-and-other-related-documents/9-6-what-is-a-coc/) .


## Looking ahead


This partnership renewal is about more than just documentation—it’s about keeping Europe’s used-car ecosystem moving with fewer obstacles. As cross-border demand continues to grow, we remain committed to improving the end-to-end customer experience through smart collaborations that remove friction, reduce delays, and help you scale your business with confidence.
